note: 受管產物目錄的宣告式清單 —— 新增一個目錄只加一筆，不寫任何 recognizer 函式。
why: 2026-07-19（老闆 msg 963）：reaper 原本是『每種產物一個 recognizer 函式』。
每新增一種產物目錄就要有人記得再寫一個函式；沒寫 = 該目錄的檔案沒有任何出口
（PHASE-Z by design 只收自己那班產的檔），於是永久 held、alert 永遠解不掉。
同一個坑踩了三次：paper/(07-14)、storage/drafts/(07-15、07-17 反轉預設)、
experiments/(07-19)。問題不是少一個 recognizer，是這個架構要求人記得補 recognizer。
所以受管目錄改成資料，掃描/收編改成一個泛型引擎。預設值是 adopt：一個 namespace
裡的檔案**就是**那個 namespace 的產物（這是目錄的定義，不是猜測），只擋真正的垃圾。

namespaces.commit_subject: chore(draft-reap): collect orphaned draft artifacts ({count} files)
namespaces.commit_body: Auto-collected by reap_orphan_deliverables: drafts, lazypack plans and figures left untracked in storage/drafts/. Root-cause: publish_draft.py registers a draft in feed.json but never commits the files, and PHASE-Z only commits what its own fire produced - so output from a crashed or out-of-lane producer was owned by no one and re-alerted every fire.

Auto-collected by reap_orphan_deliverables: results diffs are volatile-only (timestamp/runtime) and PDFs rebuild HEAD sources. Root-cause: reproduce.py verification dirties tracked artifacts that explicit-path session commits necessarily miss.

namespaces.commit_subject: chore(experiment-reap): collect orphaned experiment artifacts ({count} files)
namespaces.commit_body: Auto-collected by reap_orphan_deliverables: experiment scripts, result JSON and caches left uncommitted after the producing session ended. Root-cause: the author session that wrote them never came back, and PHASE-Z only commits what its own fire produced - so the files had no owner and re-alerted every fire.
